title: Report: John Morton to return to Broncos as offensive pass game coordinator

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Report: John Morton to return to Broncos as offensive pass game coordinator
sources.description: John Morton was a Broncos assistant before becoming the Lions' offensive coordinator ahead of the 2025 season and he's set to return to Denver after parting ways with the Lions.
